engine.name: ONNX Runtime GenAI 0.18.0 (onnxruntime 1.31.1), CPU execution provider, float32, 2 intra-op threads, through keramos/adapters/ortgenai/ortgenai_adapter.py (an in-process adapter; each GGUF exported to an HF checkpoint by adapters/common/gguf_to_hf.py v2 and built by onnxruntime_genai.models.builder -p fp32 -e cpu as shipped; generation API Generator.append_tokens / get_output('logits') / rewind_to; ONNX Runtime GenAI never reads the IR document)
engine.environment: CPython 3.12.3; the builder under transformers 5.20.2 and torch 2.14.1+cpu; onnx 1.23.2, onnx-ir 1.1.0, numpy 2.5.4; WSL2 (Ubuntu 24.04), venv on ext4 (adapters/ortgenai/requirements.txt)
engine.run: python adapters/ortgenai/ortgenai_adapter.py --adapter ortgenai --ort-dir FRESH (run_suite.sh's receipt configuration), in a clean clone of keramos at v1.3.5 (c4696bf5), fresh export and build caches, 2026-10-27. Settings: the builder unpatched; eos_token_id set to the file's unknown id where the file declares none (the tp_ files; the builder stops without one, and no case acts on it). PASS (8): tp_llama_hd16 and tp_qwen3_hd16, every case. FAILs (8): every tp_gemma3 case, the builder stopping with KeyError 'rope_type' on Gemma3ForCausalLM under transformers 5 (FINDINGS 2); every tp_mistral_hd16 case, the sliding window dropped (local_window_size -1 on both layers, FINDINGS 4). Skips: architecture 'paperkiln' (53: model 14, trace 39), the builder declining the architecture (14: MixtralForCausalLM, GPT2LMHeadModel, GPTNeoXForCausalLM, MambaForCausalLM), onnxruntime's CPU GroupQueryAttention refusing the built graph's head size at the first forward (11: pk_llama, head_size 8 with fused rotary; tp_qwen3 and tp_mistral, head_size 4; FINDINGS 1), a replacement document (5), IR validation (refuse 98, accept 40), single nodes (op 62, grad 8), digest (88), render_chat (32), dequantize (10). No earlier verdict moves.
